title: Visit to UMAANG School
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City (RCBQC) visited Umaang School, Kandivali (West), which caters to specially abled children.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City (RCBQC) visited Umaang School, Kandivali (West), which caters to specially abled children. The club supports vocational classes at the school to help students develop practical skills, encourage independence, and build confidence. The initiative aims to empower specially abled children by providing opportunities for skill development, learning, and a brighter future.
